name: 121-r3sj-boundary-readback-playing
description: No latency, build from 12 (8.081 s appended). Playing 12@~1 s: jump_to(13) in the buffer lands at 8.081, read back as 8.080999: the first snapshot and a SegmentChanged report 12 (last word) before 13. Then previous at 13@~1 s (restart threshold not reached) must go to 12, and next from 12@~0.5 s must go to 13.
